Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Just received some Jyhad packs, and one of the
cards was rather odd.
The card name is "Venture Justicar" - note the
'ur' not the 'ru'.
The card text says something about making a
Tremere into a Justicar. At first I didn't
even question it, because I thought that the
card name was a coincidence, but I decided to
check anyway.

The official card list on white wolf's site
mentions 'Venture Justicar' as an alternate
spelling to 'Ventrue Justicar', and the card
text there talks about, obviously, making
a Ventrue into a Justicar.

So was this a truly Royal Screwup in the
printing of the card (and, heh, is it worth
something?)? Is there such a card as
"Tremere Justicar" in the original Jyhad set,
and if so, what does the text say?

Are there any other cards which are _that_
messed up in the first printing?

Yes, that's basically it. There were a number
of such misprints in the original Jyhad. There
were also misprints in V:tES, though they were
a completely different set.

> Is there such a card as
> "Tremere Justicar" in the original Jyhad set,
> and if so, what does the text say?

Yes. It said just what you'd expect it to say:
"Choose a ready Tremere. Success vote means he
or she is declared Tremere Justicar. In this
vote, each Tremere gets 1 extra vote. This
could lead to a contested title."

> Are there any other cards which are _that_
> messed up in the first printing?

Yes.

Fred
